view: three-quarter, facing right (mirror for facing left)
pivot: feet centre, 4 px above the cell bottom (play: the standing feet line; the hops rise above it; drawing: the lowest point of the crouch, the chalk tip just in front of her sandals)

idle_engaged.note: in a conversation (Adam talks to her, her topic menu, an action aimed at her): the calm standing video idle instead of the hopscotch; talk and gesture cut in from it. Owner 2026-10-07: she stands still while she talks and hops only when idle.

blink.note: only while the still idle is shown (the video loops blink by themselves)

gesture.note: PlayGesture: hold, then return to idle (pointing; no in-betweens)

playing.note: default in the park: hopscotch hops on the spot (a 5.9 s loop with two hop rounds and a short pause; cell 0 = the standing still idle, so talk and gesture cut in cleanly at the loop boundary). The hopscotch squares belong to the background or a ground decal. In a conversation she stands in idle_engaged (the calm video idle) and hops again when it ends.

full.note: standing: calm video idle; every 12-25 s one hopscotch round as the idle fidget

idle_fidget.note: one pass of the hopscotch loop; starts and ends on the first cell of the idle loop

drawing.note: crouched, drawing with chalk on the ground in front of her toes (same head size as the standing set); talk, blink and the pointing gesture are crouched too

blink.note: only while the still idle is shown (the video loops blink by themselves)

gesture.note: PlayGesture: hold, then return to idle (pointing; no in-betweens)

idle_engaged.note: in a conversation: the crouched still (she stops drawing while she talks)

switching: Video loops (idle, play, draw) start and end on the still idle pose of their set: start talking at a loop boundary or cross-fade ~80 ms. Do not switch between the standing and the drawing sets on screen (no stand-up transition).
notes: S37 (manor park, Ivanka pri Dunaji, June 1962). Likeness from a family photo supplied by the owner (private; not stored in the repository). A child of seven: the standing figure is 350 px at scale 1 (adults 512 px = 1.70-1.75 m, so ~118-120 cm, 0.68 of Adam; SONA at 11 = 420 px). Variants: playing (hopscotch loop as idle), drawing (crouched, drawing with chalk).
